principle: showcase real Arc capability, no fakes

agent_1.name: nlit_soc_agent
agent_1.role: SOC threat hunter, conversational, STIG/security focus
agent_1.trigger: served arcagent process, I chat with it live on stage
agent_1.audience_sees: arcui dashboard + Obsidian graph filling up with richly-structured entities (full frontmatter populated) in real time

agent_2.name: nlit_cora_agent
agent_2.audience_sees: arcui scheduler history + the Markdown gap report

design_summary.shared: nothing (no shared vault, skills, or process)

decisions.answer: Two independent team/ projects: team/nlit_soc_agent/ and team/nlit_cora_agent/. No shared vault, no shared skills.
decisions.tier_notes: All tiers identical — location is structural, not policy

decisions.answer: Both agents are served (long-lived arcagent processes). Agent 1 is chat-driven on stage. Agent 2 is fired by built-in [modules.scheduler] overnight.
decisions.principle: Simplicity — matches existing arcagent serve pattern; scheduler is built-in

decisions.answer: Each agent's tools/ holds its own skills. No code sharing. No [extensions] paths config needed.
decisions.principle: Simplicity — no shared code, no shared bugs

decisions.answer: Typed folders + template-driven write_entity. workspace/templates/{System,Event,STIG-Reference,Incident,Finding,Person,Vendor,Process,Project}.md. write_entity takes (entity_type, name, properties), loads the matching template, fills frontmatter, writes the file with [[wikilinks]] inline. Obsidian renders graph from wikilinks. Audience sees richly-structured records, not freeform notes — that's the wow.
decisions.principle: Simplicity + demo value — templates make structure visible, no scan_and_connect needed

decisions.answer: Built-in [modules.scheduler] inside arcagent. Croniter syntax. Has circuit breaker, timeout, telemetry. Demo can show schedule store + last-run history + next-run time as part of stage walkthrough.
decisions.principle: Real Arc capability — cron stays inside Arc, not external unix cron

decisions.answer: arcui (web dashboard at localhost:8420) + Obsidian, split screen on projector. Uses existing [modules.ui_reporter] config. Audience sees agent thinking + tool calls + scheduler history + Obsidian graph in real time.
decisions.principle: Real Arc capability — ui_reporter already wired in arcagent.toml

decisions.answer: Low temperature (0.2) + strong identity.md per PRD + rehearsal. NO eval pass, NO Pydantic strict-mode demo-only validation, NO pre-recorded fallback. Honest demo — same code a real customer would run.
decisions.principle: No fakes — demo behavior must match production behavior

decisions.answer: Agent 2: hand-author 4 PRD files (system_inventory.md, stig_checklist.csv with V-220812 planted, poam_log.csv with reimaging-after-closure date mismatch, org_chart.json). Agent 1: hand-author 5-7 anchor prompts for stage — use as starting points, riff freely between.
decisions.principle: Simplicity — hand-authored = exact control over the planted finding
